panels.title: MTP acceptance length
panels.description: Tokens emitted per verify step (1 + accepted drafts).

panels.title: Token throughput
panels.description: Prefill tokens include cache hits; cached shows prefix-cache reuse.

panels.title: Per-request output speed (1 / TPOT)
panels.description: Decode speed a single user sees.

panels.title: Tokens per engine step
panels.description: Batch size distribution per step: small = decode (3 tokens/request with MTP 2), large = prefill chunks.

panels.title: Inter-token latency (per step)
panels.description: With MTP one step emits several tokens, so ITL is per verify step.

panels.title: Queue time
panels.description: Time waiting for scheduling capacity.

panels.title: Prefix cache hit rate & preemptions
panels.description: Preemptions mean KV cache ran out; should stay 0.

panels.title: Per-position acceptance
panels.description: Low acceptance at the last position suggests fewer speculative tokens.

panels.title: Tensor pipe active
panels.description: Profiling metric; empty if unsupported on this GPU/driver.

panels.title: DRAM active
panels.description: Memory-bandwidth bound decode shows high DRAM activity.

panels.title: SM clock
panels.description: MHz. Drops under load indicate power/thermal limits.

panels.title: PCIe throughput
panels.description: TP all-reduce and PLE host-table reads travel over PCIe.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: The PLE table (~51 GB) lives in pinned host memory.

panels.title: NUMA node memory used
panels.description: Needs node_exporter --collector.meminfo_numa; empty otherwise.

panels.title: RDMA throughput
panels.description: RDMA bypasses the kernel, so this comes from the HCA port counters, not netdev stats. TX is drawn negative.

panels.title: Port errors & discards
panels.description: Anything non-zero here deserves a look.

panels.title: Congestion (CNP / ECN)
panels.description: From hw_counters: np_cnp_sent / rp_cnp_handled / np_ecn_marked_roce_packets.

panels.title: Retransmits & sequence errors
panels.description: Rising values mean loss on a lossless fabric (check PFC/ECN config).

panels.title: PFC pause frames
panels.description: Per-priority pause from ethtool (mlx5 rx/tx_prioN_pause).

panels.title: Physical port bytes (incl. RDMA)
panels.description: mlx5 *_bytes_phy counts all traffic on the wire, RDMA and TCP.

panels.title: Port state
panels.description: 4 = ACTIVE.
